title: Initial Configuration Is Preserved
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $\Lambda$ be a type, and let $l\in\Lambda$, $v:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\to\mathbb{N}$, and $\mathrm{out}$ be a finite bit string. For every work-tape index $r<m$, the configuration initialized from $l$, $v$, and $\mathrm{out}$ is unchanged when its state and input-head position are reset to their initial values and work-tape head $r$ is set to position $0$.
